rows.name: Warrior
rows.description: Melee fighter focused on toughness and heavy close-range attacks. Chosen at character creation; there is no beginner class.

rows.name: Mage
rows.description: Caster focused on area damage and magical or elemental effects. Chosen at character creation; there is no beginner class.

rows.name: Rogue
rows.description: Fast, high-crit fighter with mobility and better drop luck. Chosen at character creation; there is no beginner class.
